scope: Fictional operating procedures for a recruitment demonstration. These are not actual bank policies, account records, offers, or executed actions.

workflows.customer_need: My card purchase was declined; help me complete the purchase or understand the next step.
procedure: Ask whether the customer recognizes the attempted purchase. If not, follow card_fraud immediately.
For a recognized purchase, suggest checking the merchant amount, entered card details, card status and available limit in the official bank app.
If a detail was entered incorrectly, the customer can correct it and try again once.
If the purchase still fails, route to a human specialist who can check the specific decline reason in authorized systems.
workflows.resolution: Provide actionable checks now. Never guess the actual issuer decline reason or claim to change the card status.

workflows.customer_need: Understand my card bill, due date, available limit or the difference between full and partial payment.
procedure: Explain the difference between total limit and available limit, or between the full bill and partial payment, depending on the question.
Guide the customer to check the official bank app for their own amounts, transactions, due date and contractual charges.
If the question asks for a personal amount, fees, a charge dispute or an unavailable document, route to a human specialist.
workflows.resolution: Resolve general questions in chat; never invent a personal balance, bill, interest rate or document delivery capability.

workflows.customer_need: Report an unrecognized charge, fraud or a suspected card compromise.
procedure: Treat the report as urgent and ask the customer to use the official bank app or established support channels to protect the card.
Immediately transfer the conversation to a human specialist to verify the transaction and explain the dispute process.
Do not ask for passwords, CVV or a full card number. Do not claim that a transaction was disputed or that the card was blocked.
workflows.resolution: Human transfer is required; the mock API does not execute any security action.

workflows.customer_need: Report a lost or stolen card.
procedure: Treat the report as urgent and direct the customer to the card-protection action in the official bank app or established support channels.
Immediately transfer to a human specialist for authorized verification and next steps.
Do not say the card was blocked; this demonstration has no card-blocking integration.
workflows.resolution: Human transfer is required; only official systems can confirm a card block.

workflows.customer_need: Understand repayment options or request a debt renegotiation.
procedure: Explain that a personalized proposal depends on the current contract balance and authorized bank conditions.
Suggest comparing the total amount, number and value of installments, due dates, late-payment consequences and written terms.
If the customer requests an actual proposal, a discount, a rate or approval, route to a human specialist.
workflows.resolution: Help the customer prepare for negotiation; never present a made-up offer as approved.

workflows.customer_need: Find the amount I personally owe or the status of my debt.
procedure: Explain that an individual balance can change with payments, fees and the contract terms.
Direct the customer to their official bank app or hand over to an agent with access to authorized systems.
Do not use CPF format validation or a mock registration lookup as proof of identity.
workflows.resolution: Route individual financial data requests to a human; this demonstration does not have an authenticated balance API.

workflows.customer_need: I paid a debt, but it still appears as unpaid.
procedure: Ask the customer to check the payment date and payment reference in official channels.
Route to a human specialist to verify the transaction and any applicable processing period.
Do not request a password or a full card number, or claim to have found the payment.
workflows.resolution: Explain useful checks and transfer for actual payment reconciliation.

workflows.customer_need: See my account balance, statement or personal expenses.
procedure: Direct the customer to their bank's official app for personal balance and transaction history.
Route to an authorized human specialist if the customer needs help with a specific entry.
Never fabricate account data or treat a validated CPF as bank authentication.
workflows.resolution: No real account data is available in this demonstration.

workflows.customer_need: Ask an unrelated question or a question without documented Bank IB guidance.
procedure: Ask one brief clarifying question if the request might match a documented workflow.
Otherwise route the request to a human without inventing a Bank IB product or policy.
workflows.resolution: Clarify the request or transfer it to a person.
